release_name: Live TV v3.7 — Drag-to-Resize PiP, Remote Quality Selector & Mac Favorites Sync
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🪟 Interactive Drag-to-Resize PiP: Resize PiP screen height and width by dragging the bottom-right handle or window edges with fixed 16:9 aspect ratio
🎬 Remote Video Quality Switcher: Change video resolution from the mobile remote (Auto, 1080p FHD, 720p HD, 480p SD, 360p Low)
⭐ Bidirectional Mac Favorites Sync: Your Mac's favorited channels are instantly visible and synchronized on the phone remote under 'Favorites'
⏮⏭ Remote Next & Previous Channel: Rapid channel navigation via dedicated CH + / CH - stepper rockers and Now Playing quick controls
📱 Mobile Remote Home Page: Complete channel guide with live search, category pills & 2-column channel cards
⚡ Remote Software Updates: Check for Live TV updates from mobile remote and trigger one-click Mac updates with progress indicator
Added Discovery Bangla, Discovery Kids Bangla, Discovery Science HD, Discovery Turbo HD with multi-server failover
2,989 total live channels with 3-server instant auto-failover
